QB.note: Real QB career curve indexed by years-as-starter (>=8 real games with offense_pct>0.5 in a season = a real starter season), not raw age. A separate, deliberate signal from compute_empirical_age_curves.py's real age-based curve - see QB_PEAK_AGE_INVESTIGATION.md, which explicitly decided to keep the age-based curve as computed. This file is what the trade model's QB age_curve_rising feature uses instead; RB/WR/TE are unaffected and keep using the age-based curve.
